notes: Administers the Security of Critical Infrastructure Act 2018 and the Cyber Security Act 2024. For the 2023–2030 Australian Cyber Security Strategy and Horizon Action Plans, see also secid:reference/homeaffairs.gov.au/cyber-security-strategy.

data.description: Establishes obligations for owners/operators of critical infrastructure assets across 11 sectors — asset registration, mandatory cyber incident reporting, and enhanced government assistance powers.
data.notes: See also secid:regulation/homeaffairs.gov.au/cirmp-rules for the risk-management-program rules made under this Act.

data.official_name: Security of Critical Infrastructure (Critical Infrastructure Risk Management Program) Rules 2023
data.description: Made under SOCI Act s.30AH (secid:regulation/homeaffairs.gov.au/soci-act). Requires responsible entities to establish, maintain, and comply with a written risk management program addressing cyber/physical/personnel/supply-chain hazards.

data.note: Extracted statutory section identifiers in dataset-public-laws-regulations-standards (regulation/homeaffairs.gov.au/cirmp-rules).

data.description: Enacts key legislative commitments under Horizon 1 of the 2023–2030 Australian Cyber Security Strategy: mandatory security standards for smart devices, mandatory ransomware payment reporting, a 'limited use' obligation for information shared with the National Cyber Security Coordinator, and establishment of the Cyber Incident Review Board.
data.notes: Royal Assent November 29, 2024 (Act No. 98, 2024). Implements legislative initiatives of secid:reference/homeaffairs.gov.au/cyber-security-strategy@2023-2030.
